lessons.title: The league phase
lessons.objective: You can explain the 36-team league phase.

payload.prompt: How many clubs play in the Champions League league phase now?

options.text: 24 clubs in four groups
32 clubs in eight groups
36 clubs in one league table

explanation.correct: Right. The format is 36 clubs in one table, each playing eight different opponents.
explanation.incorrect: Since 2024-25 it is 36 clubs in one league table. Each club plays eight different opponents, not everyone.
explanation.sayThisLine: Thirty-six teams, one table, eight games each.

payload.template: In the Champions League league phase, the top {{top-places}} go straight to the last 16.

explanation.correct: Exactly. The top eight teams skip the playoffs and go straight to the knockout last 16.
explanation.incorrect: The league phase top eight qualify directly for the last 16; places 9-24 enter a playoff round.

payload.prompt: How many teams from places 9 to 24 make it to the knockout stage after the playoff round?

explanation.correct: Exactly 8. Places 9-24 play a two-leg playoff; the 8 winners join the top 8 for a knockout of 16 teams.
explanation.incorrect: Eight teams from the playoff round join the top eight in the last 16. Sixteen qualify total for knockouts.

payload.prompt: Teams finishing 9th to 24th in the league phase play a playoff round. What happens next?

options.text: The winners go to the group stage
The winners join the top 8 in the last 16
The winners play one more round before the last 16

explanation.correct: Yes. The 8 playoff winners join the top 8 for the round of 16 knockout matches.
explanation.incorrect: The playoff winners go straight to the last 16. There's no extra round; it's eight automatic qualifiers plus eight playoff winners.

statement.speaker: Marco
statement.text: Top four for Champions League next year, that's the whole league title.

payload.question: What does he mean?

options.text: Finishing in the top four of his domestic league earns a Champions League spot
Only four teams can win the Champions League trophy
League position determines who qualifies for the competition
The Champions League only has four matches

payload.translation: In his domestic league, finishing top four gets him into the Champions League the following season. That's the main incentive of the league title race.

followUps.line: Does his team have a shot at top four this year?
What happens if a team finishes fifth?
followUps.why: Shows you know the cutoff matters.

payload.noFakeExpertNote: It's okay to ask which league he's talking about; that's a genuine question.

payload.prompt: Match the league phase position to the next stage.

pairs.definition: Skip the playoff round and go straight to the last 16.
Play a two-leg playoff to reach the last 16.
Eliminated from the competition; there is no drop into another cup.

explanation.summary: The league phase has three outcomes: direct last-16 entry, a playoff, or elimination.
explanation.sayThisLine: Top eight go through; nine to twenty-four play the playoffs; the rest are out.

lessons.title: Playoffs and two legs
lessons.objective: You can explain the playoff round and two-leg ties.

payload.prompt: Order these stages of a team's Champions League knockout path.

items.text: League phase: play 8 matches, aim for top 8
items.why: The first stage where all 36 clubs compete.

items.text: Playoff round (if 9-24): two legs to reach last 16
items.why: Only for the 16 teams that finish 9th to 24th.
One match to decide the champion.

explanation.correct: Right. League phase, then playoff if needed, then a knockout ladder to the final.
explanation.incorrect: The path is league phase, then playoff for teams 9-24, then the knockout rounds leading to the final.

payload.prompt: A two-leg tie ends 2-1 to one side in the first leg and 1-2 in the second. What now?

options.text: The team that won the first leg goes through
It is 3-3 on aggregate, so extra time and then penalties
Away goals decide it

explanation.correct: Right. Each team scored three in total, so it is level. Away goals no longer count (UEFA scrapped the rule in 2021), so it goes to extra time and penalties.
explanation.incorrect: Both sides have three goals across the two legs. UEFA scrapped the away-goals rule in 2021, so level ties go to extra time and then penalties.

payload.prompt: A team wins the first leg 1-0 at home. What do they need in the away leg?

options.text: To win 1-0 again
To not lose; a draw advances them
To score at least three goals

explanation.correct: Exactly. Leading 1-0 from home, any away result that doesn't lose (1-1, 0-0, any win) advances them on aggregate.
explanation.incorrect: With a 1-0 home lead, they only need to not lose the away leg. A 1-1 draw means they win 2-1 on aggregate and go through.

payload.template: If a knockout tie is level on aggregate, they play {{extra}}, and if it is still level it goes to a {{pens}}.

explanation.correct: Yes. Level on aggregate means two 15-minute halves of extra time, then a penalty shootout if it is still level.
explanation.incorrect: Level two-leg ties go to extra time (two 15-minute halves), then penalties if the score is still tied.

statement.speaker: Sofia
statement.text: It's 1-1 on aggregate so we go to extra time.

payload.question: What does she mean?

options.text: The two-leg tie is level on combined score, so extra time will decide it
She's playing in extra time instead of a second leg
The total score across both matches is tied
Extra time is played only in the first leg

payload.translation: After two legs, the aggregate score is 1-1. Now they play extra time (and then penalties if needed) to break the tie.

followUps.line: Who scored in the second leg?
followUps.why: Invites her to tell the story of the tie.

followUps.line: Is it penalties if it is still level after extra time?
followUps.why: Checks you know what comes next.

payload.noFakeExpertNote: It's okay to ask whether they replay the match or play extra time on the spot; the rule changed.

payload.prompt: Team A wins 2-0 away, then loses 0-1 at home. They are out. True or false?

scene.alt: A team scoreboard showing results from two legs.

explanation.correct: False. They won 2-0 away and lost 0-1 at home, so they are 2-1 up on aggregate and go through.
explanation.incorrect: The aggregate is 2-1 to Team A, so they advance. The home loss does not undo the away win.

lessons.title: Why Champions League nights feel different
lessons.objective: You can talk about big European nights.

payload.prompt: What makes Champions League nights feel different from domestic league matches?

options.text: The opponents are from different countries and cultures, and the stakes are continental
Champions League matches are always in the afternoon
Only the biggest stadiums can host Champions League

explanation.correct: Right. European nights mean facing clubs from across the continent with different styles, histories and fans. It's a step up in scale.
explanation.incorrect: Champions League matches are often played at night under lights, with foreign fans, different tactics and the weight of continental competition. It's a different atmosphere.

statement.speaker: Yuki
statement.text: Champions League nights are just different. The whole stadium is different.

payload.question: What does she mean?

options.text: The atmosphere, tension and scale feel bigger than domestic matches
Champions League matches are only played at night
The stadium is larger for European matches
Fans, tension and the weight of European football create a special energy

payload.translation: She feels the scale and intensity of European football: the foreign fans, the tension, the history of these continental matches.

followUps.line: What was your favourite Champions League night?
followUps.why: Invites her to share a memory.

followUps.line: Does your team play well in these big matches?

payload.noFakeExpertNote: You can share that you've felt the atmosphere change in European matches if you have.

payload.prompt: Which club has won the most European Cup / Champions League titles?

options.text: Real Madrid
AC Milan
Liverpool

explanation.correct: Right. Real Madrid have won it 15 times, more than anyone else, which is why they treat the competition as their own.
explanation.incorrect: Real Madrid hold the record with 15. AC Milan and Liverpool are among the next best, but Madrid are far ahead.
explanation.sayThisLine: Real Madrid and Europe, that is a long love story.

statement.speaker: Hassan
statement.text: PSG beat Arsenal in penalties. The 2026 final was wild.

payload.question: What does he mean?

options.text: PSG and Arsenal played the 2026 Champions League final
PSG and Arsenal play every year in the final
The match went to a penalty shootout after 90 minutes
The 2026 final ended in a draw, then was decided by penalties

payload.translation: PSG and Arsenal played the 2026 Champions League final in Budapest. It finished 1-1 and PSG won 4-3 on penalties.

followUps.line: Have you watched a Champions League final before?
Do you remember who was playing?
followUps.why: Checks if they're sharing a real memory.

payload.noFakeExpertNote: It's fine to say you didn't watch the final or didn't remember it; that's honest.

payload.title: Champions League night
payload.setting: She is excited about a big European match coming up.

exchanges.theirMessage: Champions League night on Wednesday. I can't sleep already.

replies.text: Who are you playing and what's the vibe around it?
replies.theirResponse: A famous club from Italy. It's huge for us.
replies.coachNote: Shows you get why European nights matter.
Never dismiss the scale of European football.

payload.closingNote: She feels the weight and excitement of a big European night. She wants you to share that sense of occasion.
